questions.question: Verify the official name of the 1997 science writing award and the academy membership.

localizations.source: Verify the official name of the 1997 science writing award and the academy membership.
localizations.ru: Уточнить официальное название премии за научную публицистику 1997 года и сведения об академическом членстве.

questions.resolution: In 1997 Gardner was elected a Fellow of the American Academy of Arts and Sciences and received the American Physical Society’s Forum Award for Promoting Public Understanding of the Relationships of Physics and Society: https://www.amacad.org/sites/default/files/media/document/2019-10/ChapterG.pdf and https://engage.aps.org/fps/resources/newsletters/newsletter-archives/april-1997

questions.question: The English list explicitly translates Russian-edition titles and retains their dates. Confirm this presentation or map each Russian edition to its specific English original.

localizations.source: The English list explicitly translates Russian-edition titles and retains their dates. Confirm this presentation or map each Russian edition to its specific English original.
localizations.ru: В EN список прямо обозначен как перевод названий русских изданий с сохранением их дат. Согласовать эту форму или сопоставить каждое русское издание с конкретным английским оригиналом.

questions.resolution: The list explicitly translates the Russian-edition titles and retains the publication data for those editions.

questions.question: For the photograph of Martin Gardner, establish a public source, the photographer or rights holder, and a licence or permission; for the 1971 Russian book cover, identify the exact edition and publisher and the basis for reproduction. “Illustration accompanying the text” establishes none of these facts.

localizations.source: For the photograph of Martin Gardner, establish a public source, the photographer or rights holder, and a licence or permission; for the 1971 Russian book cover, identify the exact edition and publisher and the basis for reproduction. “Illustration accompanying the text” establishes none of these facts.
localizations.ru: Для фотографии Мартина Гарднера установить публичный источник, фотографа или правообладателя и лицензию либо разрешение; для русской обложки книги 1971 года указать точное издание, издателя и основание воспроизведения. Формулировка «Иллюстрация к материалу» этого не подтверждает.
